Control Shift Video is looking for a freliable, detail-oriented freelance illustrator to collaborate with our core team on a variety of projects. Our work spans technology, healthcare, energy, consumer brands, and nonprofits — and we’re always looking for illustrators who can help bring complex ideas to life with clarity and style.
What You’ll Be Doing
Creating custom illustrations for video, motion graphics, web, and brand content
Collaborating with our creative team to develop visual styles, concepts, and story-driven imagery
Translating scripts, ideas, or loose concepts into clear, compelling visuals
Preparing artwork for animation, motion, or digital delivery
Iterating based on feedback while maintaining consistency and quality

Strong illustration skills with a clear, cohesive style (or styles)
Experience creating artwork for video, motion graphics, or digital platforms
Ability to simplify complex or technical ideas visually
Comfort working independently while collaborating with a creative team
Reliable communication, meeting deadlines, and delivering what you promise
Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or similar tools
Motion or animation experience is a plus, but not required.
How We Work
Remote-first and flexible
Project-based engagements with clear scopes and timelines
Respectful collaboration — we treat freelancers like partners, not resources
Clear feedback, fair rates, and no last-minute chaos whenever possible

You’ll work on meaningful projects with real impact
We value creativity, curiosity, and people who take pride in their craft
We keep our word and expect the same in return
You’ll be part of a trusted creative network we return to often

We are looking for a creative and passionate individual to join our team as a volunteer 2D Concept Artist! In this volunteer position, you will be asked to create a variety of high-quality concept art and/or illustrative work for The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO).

Interested applicants must be advised that this is a long-term volunteer project, and as such, you must be ready to contribute to the game on a long-term basis (however, as this is an unpaid position, full-time dedication is not expected).

A variety of different concept types, such as characters, creatures, landscape, architecture, etc, may be required. For illustrative work, you may be asked to create illustrations that will be used as in-game paintings (and should replicate various medieval painting styles).

Concept Art and Illustration should be created in a timely manner on demand; while there is no set amount of time that a team member should put into the project, it is expected for each work to be handled within a reasonable timeframe. Multiple applicants may be accepted; this job is not for a single position.

Communication is key to a smooth and efficient working pipeline. Therefore, the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with other team members is essential. It is also important to not afraid to ask and discuss, and find out the solution should any problems arise.

We are an English-speaking team, so proficiency in the English language is a must. What you’ll be doing: Partner with the Art Director and other team members to pioneer the vision of the game. Design, create, and develop high-quality sketches and quick iterations digitally (you can do it on paper but the finished artwork must be digital).

Create and develop original concepts of characters, environment, and props based on references or from scratch. Attend weekly meetings with the whole team on Slack (instant messaging software we use for communication). Present concepts and ideas to the team for further discussion.

Creatively problem-solve and figure out efficient solutions to executing the look and feel of the character and environment. Achieve a balance between artistic aspects and technical constraints. Adjust the artwork styles to meet the game’s art direction. Set your own reasonable deadlines, and make sure the work is done on time.

Minimum Requirements: Working knowledge of design and drawing programs such as photoshop, illustrator, procreate, or your program of choice. Excellent understanding of art fundamentals: lighting, composition, architecture, human anatomy, etc.

Ability to create high-quality concept art and illustrations of characters, creatures, environments, architecture, and more. Ability to give and take feedback professionally and applies it to the art and design. Flexibility and adaptive capabilities. Able to collaborate and work as a part of the team. Fluency in English is a must.

Recommended Requirements: Experience in game design or game developing industry. Shipped 1 or more video game titles. Educational background in art, design, or other related fields Experience in Unreal Engine 5 Epoch Games is a volunteer-based, all-online, global game development team.

We have no centrally-located headquarters and are unincorporated at this time.

Most of the original founding members were modders developing the total conversion Middle Earth Roleplaying Project (MERP) mod for the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: http://www.moddb.com/mods/merp-middle-earth-roleplaying-project Currently Epoch Games is developing The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO).

LoA:SO is an in-development indie open-world RPG set in an original fantasy world.

The game is being developed using Epic Games' Unreal Engine 5 (UE5): https://www.unrealengine.com/ For more information about the game, please check out our IndieDb page: http://www.indiedb.com/games/the-lays-of-althas-sundered-order NOTE: The address above is the address related to Epoch Games ' Incorporation, but is not related to the place of work.

We are a fully-online team with no central headquarters at this time. Communication is mostly done via Slack (an instant messaging application) and Trello (an online project collaboration tool). Originally posted on Himalayas

You are an early-career illustrator with genuine drawing talent and a real eye for cute, playful, kid-friendly design. You love to make art and you want to keep doing exactly that. This is the work you want to grow in, not a stepping stone into something else.

You take creative direction cleanly, you learn a style fast, and you can carry a piece all the way to finished without needing it handed back to you. You thrive in a remote, fast-moving environment where new products ship every month, and you are excited to build your portfolio inside a brand that reaches millions of families.
Must-haves
A portfolio of original illustration work that shows a cute, playful, kid-friendly or product-design sensibility.
Working proficiency in Adobe Illustrator for native illustration (not just file handling or layout).
Ability to match and extend an existing art style, completing a set so new pieces sit naturally alongside the originals.
Strong ability to take written and verbal creative direction and turn it into finished work.
Reliability on deadlines while managing several pieces at once.
Nice-to-haves
Experience preparing print / production files to spec.
Familiarity with the children's, educational, or consumer-product space.
Comfort with lightweight project tools (Notion, ClickUp) and file organization.
Note: this is an entry-level maker's role. We are not looking for a senior art director or a veteran illustrator. We are looking for real talent early in its arc, with the interest and hunger to grow.
As our Junior Product Illustrator, your one job is to turn the Chief Creative Officer's vision into finished, on-style product art, so Hadley Designs launches new products faster and our creative capacity is multiplied, not capped by a single set of hands.

The CCO sets the tone, the style, and the strategy; you carry the hands-on execution, creating new artwork, completing sets in an established style, and building each concept out to production-ready. This is a deliberately early-career seat for someone with real illustration talent who wants to keep growing that craft.

You will not be expected to arrive as a seasoned art director. You will be expected to draw well, learn our style quickly, take direction cleanly, and finish the last mile of the creative so the CCO can stay focused on setting direction rather than executing it.

Original Illustration & Artwork: Create new artwork and complete sets in Hadley Designs' established style across our product lines.
Product Design Execution: Turn the CCO's concepts and creative direction into finished, production-ready product designs.
Creative Production Support: Own the execution offload (variations, building out a design across a full set, and file prep) that frees the CCO's hands.
Style Consistency: Keep every piece on-style and on-brand across the full product set.
As-needed: occasional ad-ops support (A+ content, storefront updates, CMYK ad images) and revisions on existing product lines. This is secondary support, not the core of the role.
How Success Is Measured

New original art created
Sets / SKUs completed
On-time delivery
Framework-to-finish independence
Remote, full-time role with a flexible schedule.
You’ll join a high-growth team that values innovation, data-driven decision making, and collective wins.
Access to cash, tools, and the autonomy to execute with trust.
Regular interaction with the CEO and an established company culture built over 10+ years.
Personal development opportunities
Autonomy of time and schedule, and a challenging
Rewarding environment designed to scale with you.

As a Concept Artist at Riot you will bring characters, creatures, environments and props to life. Drawing inspiration from as little as a napkin sketch or as much as a full-blown narrative concept, you will generate ideas and craft designs that are resonant, compelling and iconic. As a problem solver, first and foremost, you will help come up with visual solutions for game concepts.
As a Principal Concept Artist for League of Legends at Riot Games, you will bring champions, and gameplay moments to life through compelling, stylized visuals. Your work will help define iconic experiences for players around the world.

You’ll join the League of Legends, where you’ll navigate constrained game design spaces and find elegant, thoughtful ways to express fantasy. Reporting to the Concept Art Lead, you’ll help shape the future of League’s art style, set standards through your work, and uplift your teammates through feedback and mentorship.

This role is for someone who thrives on creative problem-solving, deeply understands the League IP, and believes that player delight starts with strong visual storytelling.

Partner with creative leadership to explore new cosmetic thematics that elevate League’s champions, environments and express powerful fantasy
Concept compelling characters, environments, props, and skin lines that support gameplay clarity, aesthetic appeal, and originality
Translate design intent and gameplay constraints into visually satisfying concepts that align with League’s art and game design direction
Develop moodboards, style guides, and pitch materials grounded in research, taste, and trend awareness. Create production-ready concept art and orthographics for 3D artists, VFX, and animation teams
Actively participate in craft reviews and offer/receive feedback with clarity and intent
Mentor and support other artists by modeling quality, consistency, and collaboration
Work closely with cross-disciplinary partners to ensure visual solutions serve both gameplay and fantasy

10+ years of professional experience in concept art for games or animation
A strong portfolio highlighting early ideation, a range of visual styles, and case studies that showcase your process and creative decision-making, with concept work across characters, props, and environments, balancing visual storytelling with gameplay clarity
Expert-level proficiency in Photoshop (or equivalent software)
Strong grasp of stylized art fundamentals: anatomy, form, lighting, color, and value
Ability to draw inspiration from diverse sources including fantasy, pop culture, historical references, and global trends
Strong communicator who thrives in collaborative, interdisciplinary environments

Shipped content for at least AAA title
Familiarity with League of Legends, its champions, cosmetics, and player expectations
Experience designing for isometric camera gameplay
Ability to deliver broad-appeal visuals while pushing boundaries in creative expression
Learning mindset and openness to evolving tools and workflows
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.
At Riot Games, we put players first . That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission.

And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.
It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc.

Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law.

We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.
Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:
Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters
These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

Designing format and lay-out for illustrations, posters, flyers, program covers, certificates, signs, tickets, T-shirts, patches, logos, and special items.
Producing all necessary art work; preparing rough sketches or illustrations in pen and ink, pencil, watercolors, markers, or by any other method which is appropriate for the project.
Designing cover of layout work of newsletters and other programs and activities.
Designing and painting, signs, graphics and notices for various recreational facilities, clubs, etc.
Performing lettering of certificates for awards in connection with the various programs.
Resumes must be two pages (or less). Resumes should clearly demonstrate the applicant's relevant experience, skills, knowledge and abilities as they pertain to this position. A qualified candidate must possess the following: Demonstrated ability to perform the duties of the position. Experience must be reflected on resume to receive credit.

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts , processing billions of Naira’s in transactions monthly . Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere .

We are looking for a talented Illustrator to create original pieces of artwork for Moniepoint products . You will work as part of our User Experience, digital & creative team , interpreting complex briefs and developing inspiring artwork that will attract our target audience .

You will be responsible for formulating concepts and rendering draft illustrations from written w ords, models, sketched ideas, and from your imagination . Ultimately, we are hiring a creative individual who can turn concepts into artistic marketable images .

Prepare rough draft illustrations according to requirements and the company’s specifications and needs .
Create complete illustrations and refine design concepts using a wide range of colors, graphics, effects, and illustration software .
Apply isometric techniques to add perspective to complex visual shapes .
Ensure that all digital illustrations meet high quality and color standards .
Brainstorm with the design team to come up with new creative ideas, patterns, visual styles, and concepts .
Stay up-to-date with emerging design techniques, industry trends, and graphics software .

Bachelor's degree in fine arts, design, visual arts, or a related field .
At least 4-5 years of proven work experience as an Illustrator, Graphic Designer, or similar visual design role .
A strong portfolio demonstrating a diverse range of completed illustrations .
Proven hands-on work experience using computer-aided design (CAD) software .

Advanced drawing, painting, and digital artwork rendering skills .
Deep expertise in image editing and design tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop .
Strong conceptual thinking and artistic problem-solving abilities .
Ability to manage time effectively, work under pressure, and meet strict deadlines .

s.h: What Success Looks Like in This Role
s.t:
Consistently transforming abstract product ideas into engaging, marketable visual assets across touchpoints .
High brand aesthetic consistency and technical alignment across all digital art and user experiences .
Active creative collaboration with design teams to co ntinually elevate Moniepoint's visual language and illustration standards .
Reliable and on-time delivery of high-quality illustrations that satisfy complex cross-functional briefs .

Cultur e: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member . We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and wher e all voices are heard . We value and respect each other and always look out for one another . Above all, we are human .
Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks .
Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits .

About Voodoo
Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.
This remote role is located within a two-hour time difference of CET.
Team
Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.
Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.
You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2 .
With Paper.io 2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!
We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.
Role
As a Concept Artist focusing on Concept Art , you will play a vital role in shaping the visual identity of Paper.io 2 . Collaborating closely with the Art Director , you will create, develop, and integrate stunning game assets, elevating the production quality of our live games as we transition them into the casual space .

Design and produce high-quality concept art for characters, environments, and props.
Work on illustrations for icons or stylised assets that align with the game’s aesthetic.
Creating key art illustrations with final render.

Partner with the Art Director to align on visual style and direction.
Actively contribute by providing creative ideas and constructive feedback.

Gather references, brainstorm ideas, and create mock-ups that clearly communicate the artistic vision.
Contribute to the creative direction by delivering compelling and innovative designs.
Profile

4+ years as a Concept Artist, in the mobile gaming industry.
Strong capabilities in concept art, including a keen eye for detail, composition, and style.
Ability to adapt to different visual styles and produce assets that align with the game’s vision.
Strong Illustration skills

Skilled in tools like Maya, Blender, Unity, and Photoshop.
Proficient in low-poly modelling and texturing pipelines; familiarity with Maya rigging workflows is a plus.
Experience working with Unity
Familiar with AI pipelines

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team.
Resourceful and proactive, with the ability to troubleshoot and iterate effectively.
Strong problem-solving abilities

Create low-poly 3D models, including texturing, to meet both technical and artistic requirements.
Experience in VFX creation or animation.

Main Mission
We're looking for a Senior Concept Artist to join a new PC/Console third-person cozy life-sim game currently in pre-production. With a particular focus on environment art , you'll help shape the game's world, atmosphere, and player experience.
What It Means on a Daily Basis
Create concept art for games, mainly focused on environments, taking ideas from the initial brief through exploration, development, polish, and final production-ready images.
Explore different visual solutions through sketches, ideation, mood pieces, and more developed concepts. Use your artistic judgement to solve visual and design problems and help bring the game's visual direction to life.
Work closely with artists, designers, Art Leadership, and Production to solve creative challenges and make sure your concepts are useful and practical for the rest of the team.
Take feedback on board and refine your work while considering aspects like: artistic quality, readability, scale, cost, reuse, modularity, gameplay needs.
Use modern Concept Art workflows, including AI-assisted tools, and contribute ideas that can make the team's creative process more efficient.
What Success Will Look Like
First Month
Build a strong understanding of the project's visual language, workflows, production context, and priorities.
Become familiar with the team's standards and begin contributing meaningful visual solutions.
First 3 Months
Become fully integrated into the team and take ownership of increasingly complex visual development challenges.
Independently develop and communicate multiple visual solutions, balancing artistic quality with production needs.
Build a solid collaboration with the rest of the game creation team
After 6-12 Months
Take ownership of major areas of the game’s environment concept development.
Manage complex visual development topics and challenges, delivering production-useful concepts that support the wider development team.
Who You'll Be Working With
You'll report to the Principal Concept Artist Lead and join a team of 13 Concept Artists.
The Concept Art team in Bucharest.
Concept Artists from international co-development teams in Saigon, Yogyakarta, and Kyiv.
Designers, Art teams, and Production teams across the project.
Your Recruitment Journey
HR Interview (40 min): A Teams discussion to learn more about the role, the team, and your experience.
Art Test: A practical concept art exercise based on a brief similar to the work you’d do on the project. We'll look at both the final result and your creative process, including how you explored options and approached design decisions.
Technical Interview: A discussion with the Principal Concept Artist Lead around your art test and portfolio, how you approached them, the choices you made, and how you usually work through visual and production problems.
Final Interview: A discussion with our Studio Manager about how you think, make decisions, take ownership and work with others.
What You Need to Succeed
Proven experience creating concept art for games, supported by a portfolio showcasing environment concept art, visual development, and world building.
Excellent Photoshop skills and practical experience with Blender or a similar 3D software package for ideation, blockouts, and concept exploration.
Good ideation skills, with the ability to quickly explore multiple meaningful visual solutions through sketches and developed artwork.
Excellent fundamental artistic knowledge on drawing, composition, perspective, color, value, proportions, lighting, visual design, shape language, visual hierarchy.
A solid understanding of game development Concept Art workflows and production awareness, including how concepts support other Art Departments such as 3D, Animation, and VFX.

s.h: It will be a plus if
s.t:
You have experience with Unreal Engine
You are comfortable with AI-assisted workflows for Concept Art
You have experience with characters and prop design

You are a creative problem-solver who can explore, evaluate, and refine visual solutions based on feedback.
You are a clear communicator who works well with artists, designers, art leadership, and production stakeholders.
You are creative, curious, design-oriented, and solution-focused, with good visual judgment.
You are self-driven and organized, able to manage complex work independently and take ownership of the outcome.
You are proactive about improving both your craft and the quality, usefulness, and efficiency of the final result.
Where This Role Can Take You
This role offers several growth opportunities depending on your interests, performance, and aspirations.
Senior 2
Take ownership of more complex tasks and larger areas of work.
Support and provide feedback to other artists.
Develop a broader understanding of game development and production.
Principal Concept Artist
Become a subject matter expert with deep artistic and production knowledge.
Influence artistic direction, workflows, and best practices across projects.
Lead Concept Artist

s.h: Guide and support artists across the team.
s.t:
Coordinate creative work and help drive project delivery.
Partner with art and production stakeholders to balance quality and project needs.
What's in it for you
2 months/year full remote work from anywhere
MyBenefits platform - 45 RON/day
Extra days off for seniority, birthday and company anniversary
Short Fridays, so you can start your weekend at 4PM
Medical subscription with Regina Maria
Life at Gameloft
Hybrid work model
Free coffee, fruits, and relaxation areas
Inclusive and international work environment;
Supportive team culture and open communication style;
How to proceed
Want to be part of a creative, collaborative, and multicultural environment alongside talented industry professionals? Apply now with your CV in English and your portfolio.
If your experience matches the role, one of our recruiters will contact you to share more details about the opportunity and guide you through the next steps of the recruitment process.

s.h: WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON
s.t:
Main challenge
Create polished 2D concept art assets and illustrations/splash screens that fit the visual direction of the game and support a consistent player experience. You will translate artistic requirements and feedback into production-ready assets while working within established visual styles, guidelines and project requirements.
What it means on a daily basis

· Create concept art for buildings , characters, vehicles and items, following the game's art direction and guidelines

· Create illustrations, splash screens and loading screens following the game's art direction and guidelines

· Adapt your work to different game styles while maintaining visual consistency and quality

· Collaborate with Artists, Animators, Designers and Developers to ensure assets are ready for integration into the game

· Review and implement feedback and revisions, while delivering work according to agreed requirements and timelines

· Research and present ideas for new assets and features, taking ownership of your work from concept to delivery
What success will look like

· High-quality, polished assets that elevate game ergonomics and overall player experience

· Smooth integration of the assets into the development pipeline without technical friction

· Proactive ownership of assigned tasks and steady creative adaptation to different game genres and graphic styles.
Who you would be working with
You will report to the Lead Artist, who will provide direction on your tasks, revisions, workflows, training and creative development. You will collaborate with another Artists, Animators, Designers, Developers, Producers and other members of the game team.
Your recruitment journey

· Step 1 – CV & Portfolio screening

· Step 2 - A practical art task to showcase your creative logic and technical skills

· Step 3 - Final interview in person at our office with the game Producer, Lead Artist and HR Representative
Where this role can take you
This position offers direct room to deepen your expertise in game art, master new tools, take on broader creative ownership within international projects, and progress towards Senior or even Lead Artist roles

· Previous professional experience as an Artist in the gaming industry

· A strong portfolio demonstrating art skills in general - concept art, hard surface design, illustrations and polished rendering techniques

· Advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Blender or any other 3D software will be considered a plus

· Excellent communication, task ownership, and organizational skills

· Professional working proficiency in English

· You are a 2D Concept Artist who can work within an established visual direction while maintaining a high level of attention to detail and visual quality

· You are comfortable receiving feedback, making revisions and collaborating with people from different disciplines

· You can organize your work, communicate clearly about your tasks and adapt your approach when project requirements or visual directions change

· You are interested in developing your skills and learning new tools and techniques as part of your work

· Additional health insurance including dental care and glasses reimbursement

· Hybrid work model with flexible working hours and shorter Fridays

· Food vouchers – 102 EUR per month

· Access to Multisport or Coolfit sports cards

· 20 days paid annual leave plus one additional day off for your birthday

· Referral bonus and baby bonus

· Modern office at Sofia Tower 2 (Mall of Sofia)

· Gaming area with table tennis, air hockey, PlayStation 5, and board games

· Weekly fruit and snacks, daily hot beverages

· Access to internal trainings, studio library, and career development support

· Studio events, social gatherings, and charity initiatives

· Occasional gifts for special occasions

· Discount program with selected retailers and services

How to proceed
If you see yourself in this description, please send us your CV and portfolio. We will process your application with full confidentiality and contact you if your profile matches our needs.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) artiste de concept intermédiaire qui mettra à contribution ses talents dans notre projet PC/console Dungeons & Dragons®. Ce jeu novateur fusionnera des mécaniques action-RPG/survie avec les éléments uniques des jeux de simulation de vie pour redéfinir le genre et captiver l'imagination des joueurs du monde entier.

Créer des personnages, des créatures et des environnements attrayants en se basant sur les directives du Directeur artistique et les commentaires de l'équipe de conception du jeu
Créer un style unique et cohérent pour un univers de jeu complet
Itérer rapidement sur des idées grâce à des croquis et des miniatures
Créer des concepts pour la production quotidienne d'assets artistiques en jeu
Créer des illustrations promotionnelles extraordinaires qui respectent l'histoire et la direction créative du jeu
Communiquer des idées visuelles à travers les équipes et les départements
Fournir des illustrations de haute qualité dans les délais impartis, avec un grand souci du détail
***
We're on the lookout for an Intermediate concept artist to contribute their skills to our Dungeons & Dragons® PC/console project. This innovative game will blend action-RPG/survival features with the unique elements of life-simulation games to redefine the genre and capture the imaginations of players worldwide.

Creating compelling characters, creatures, and environments based on direction from the Art Director and input from the game design team
Crafting a unique and consistent style for a complete game world
